dominant_shape: A white-hot line inside a saturated blue beam with a wide dim rim; noise streams outward along it, steam, sparks, cooling scorch and smouldering smoke stay where it lands, and it stays locked to its end point while the game rakes it.

beats.name: ignition
beats.expect: A white flash at the mouth as a thin beam shoots to its end point

beats.name: full power
beats.expect: White core inside a saturated blue body with a dim rim; sparks at the end

beats.name: rake
beats.expect: The end point has climbed toward the target; the beam stays attached to it

beats.name: release
beats.expect: The beam narrows and fades within a quarter second; steam is left at the end

beats.name: steam
beats.expect: Rising steam and cooling scorch marks along the raked path

beats.name: exit
beats.expect: Smouldering smoke along the raked path is still thinning out

acceptance: The beam keeps a white core and a blue body; it never turns into a white bar
The end flash, sparks and steam stay on the moving end point
Ignition and release read in a few frames, not as a slow fade
avoid: A beam that pinches at either end
Sparks that stay glued to the end point after it moves on
